text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono hasn't shown up to training, and when I go off in search of someone who might have seen her…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm! This new macaron parfait is so crunchy and syrupy and buono! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I had no idea this combination would work this well. I'll have to recreate it for everyone else to try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's see… Which stores still have new desserts I haven't tried?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! Oh no! I'm so sorry! I forgot to check the time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her to be more careful next time…
